announcement: Independent 3D texturing · Windows, with a Linux beta
heroTitle:
Layers when you paint.
*Procedural when you need it.*
heroLede: Paint with layers. Build with nodes. Keep both in one material workflow.
heroNote: One material. Two connected ways to create.
introTitle:
One workspace.
*Two connected ways to work.*
introBody: Paint and build materials with layers, then open the graph to shape and reuse the procedural logic behind them. Baking, UV checks and material review stay part of the same asset workflow.
donateTitle: Made by one developer, for artists
donateBody: Surface3D is a solo project built around a simple goal: give artists an open, approachable alternative to expensive texturing tools. Support helps fund development time, testing, documentation and distribution.

news.title: Texture work, kept in flow
news.body: Paint on the model, work with clear layers, and open the graph whenever you want deeper control.

news.title: Build a surface once
news.body: Shape procedural details into reusable outputs for the materials and layers in your project.

news.title: A tool growing with artists
news.body: Surface3D is evolving around practical texturing workflows, clear controls, and reliable output.

features.title: Layers and folders
features.body: Build a surface with fill, paint and effect layers while every part stays editable.
features.points:
Fill and paint layers, masks, blend modes and channel opacity
Color, lock, group and merge; thumbnails show each layer
Paint at 2K and 4K, about 20x faster at 12 layers in 0.90

features.title: Brushes and paint tools
features.body: A full painting toolset on the model.
features.points:
Brush, eraser, smudge, clone, fill, mask brush, decals
Pen pressure, symmetry, smoothing and stencils
Splines and particles
Gradients along strokes

features.title: Sculpting
features.body: Dent, fold, carve and inflate the surface in a live Sculpt layer.
features.points:
Clay, crease, pinch, flatten, scrape and more
Cloth brushes that form folds as relief
Smart masks follow your sculpt

features.title: Edge damage
features.body: Chips and dents along real mesh edges and bevels, updated live.
features.points:
Works on bevels and real meshes
Pick which edges get damaged
Feeds smart masks like a high-poly bake

features.title: Anchors and effects
features.body: Reuse any layer result further up the stack.
features.points:
Anchor a layer mask or material
One effect browser with node-style cards
Filters, generators and blend per effect

features.title: Teach masks
features.body: Paint where an effect should go and where it should not. Surface3D learns the rule and fills the whole model.
features.points:
Learns 25 things: edges, cavities, water flow, metal, wood grain…
A readable rule you can adjust with sliders
Drips that run down from the edges you teach

features.title: Physical weathering
features.body: Rust, moss, dirt, dust and leak stains computed from how they form on this model.
features.points:
Five templates, no bakes needed
Age, amount and climate controls
"See why" shows the measurement behind it

features.title: Smart masks and generators
features.body: Ready-made masks driven by your baked maps.
features.points:
Hundreds of patterns and generators
Grunge with triplanar mapping
Searchable library with previews

features.title: Node graphs connected to your layers
features.body: Use a graph where procedural control helps, then combine it with paint.
features.points:
235+ procedural nodes
Live anchors and named outputs
Nested graphs with exposed controls

features.title: Tileable materials and patterns
features.body: Build repeating surfaces, or start from a photograph.
features.points:
Tiles, shapes, noises, samplers and splatters
Offset and seam cleanup with paint and cloning
Results from photos depend on the source

features.title: Paint and text inside a graph
features.body: Add hand-made marks to procedural work.
features.points:
Paint nodes and clone cleanup
Text nodes
Vertex colors as inputs
Color and Value Gradient nodes

features.title: One-click high-to-low baking
features.body: Pick the low mesh, the high mesh and the size, then Bake. Parts are paired for you.
features.points:
Normal, AO, curvature, thickness, position, bent normal and ID
Hardware ray tracing where available, fast compute otherwise
Fills gutters and repairs more by itself
features.statusDetail: Engine availability depends on your hardware.

features.title: Cages you can see and paint
features.body: When something looks wrong, the Bake panel shows where.
features.points:
"N spots need attention" colors them on the model
Paint the cage out or in
Only the changed texels rebake

features.title: Very dense high meshes
features.body: Meshes with hundreds of millions of triangles load once into a cache.
features.points:
Many common mesh formats
Loads in the background
Mesh import cleans broken triangles and normals

features.title: UV workspace
features.body: Inspect islands, unwrap, and pack them tightly.
features.points:
Inspect, unwrap and transform
Automatic packing
Triplanar and other projection modes

features.title: Rendering workspace
features.body: Review your asset before exporting it.
features.points:
Cameras, lights and HDRI environments
Turntable, depth of field and post-processing
Wireframe with color and thickness

features.title: Shaders per texture set
features.body: Choose the shader that fits the surface.
features.points:
Skin, Foliage / thin, Clear coat and more
Translucency uses your Thickness map
Specular level for every shader

features.title: Export for your 3D workflow
features.body: Take your maps into any 3D software that supports standard PBR textures.
features.points:
Presets for popular game engines and glTF
Choose channels and resolution
Color and data maps kept distinct

features.title: Library and free online materials
features.body: Keep useful results and pull in free materials.
features.points:
Thousands of CC0 materials and textures to download
Drag one straight onto a layer or the model
Save layers and folders as assets with their controls

features.title: An interface that fits you
features.body: Five workspaces with dockable panels that can float.
features.points:
13 languages, including right-to-left
Themes you can share as files
Rebind every shortcut; Ctrl+K finds any command

features.title: Windows and Linux beta
features.body: Native app with its own GPU renderer on Vulkan.
features.points:
Windows x64: Vulkan or Direct3D 11
Linux x86_64 AppImage in beta
Built-in updater on Windows
features.statusDetail: The Linux beta has not yet been tested on a real GPU or desktop.

features.title: Faster high-resolution iteration
features.body: Reducing pauses when editing very large stacks and complex graphs.
features.points:
Smarter result reuse
More targeted updates

features.title: A broader artist asset library
features.body: More editable patterns, masks and material starting points.
features.points:
Organized by practical use
Ready to use in layers or graphs

homepage.layerBody: Build materials with fills, paint, masks and effects.
homepage.graphBody: Connect textures, mesh maps and generators. Reuse the result in your layers.
homepage.bakeBody: Capture surface detail from your mesh. Check normals, curvature and occlusion directly on the object.
homepage.uvBody: Inspect your islands, make a quick transform, unwrap and pack. Keep texture placement clear before the final material pass.
homepage.renderBody: Check your materials under HDRI lighting. Export standard PBR maps for your 3D workflow.
homepage.aboutTitle: One developer. A connected material workspace.
homepage.aboutGoal: Make capable 3D texturing accessible to every artist: familiar layers when you paint, procedural control when you need it, and smart tools that understand the model.
homepage.aboutBuild: A native application with its own GPU renderer, so painting, sculpting and masks stay fast at 2K and 4K.
homepage.aboutDevelopment: Surface3D is developed independently, with frequent releases shaped by artist feedback on Discord. Every release is listed with its changes on GitHub.
homepage.aboutExperience: Surface3D grew out of my own work texturing environments and props. It brings together the tools and workflows I wanted while making those assets.
homepage.aboutAI: Surface3D is built with the help of AI agents. I guide the product using my experience in 3D environment and prop texturing; AI agents help write, debug and improve the code. If you prefer not to use or support software built with AI agents, please take that into account before downloading or supporting the project.
homepage.aboutOriginality: Surface3D is an original, independently developed project. It is not decompiled or reverse-engineered software, and it is not a clone. It brings layer-based painting and procedural material creation together in a new workflow.
homepage.aboutIntro: A native texturing app for painting, sculpting, smart weathering and procedural materials, made by a 3D artist for artists. Free for Windows, with a Linux beta.
